arStrings.szText: "You said the dagger was sculpted of your own bone. You could have made another."
You truly do not grasp the scale of our war, do you? My father will never die. To delay him, however long, is an act of desperation. And it is not without cost.
Close proximity. A harsh teacher, teaching an important lesson
The day I forged that blade, I gave up a piece of myself. I was forever weaker for it. Would I sacrifice more, for a mere reprieve?
No. This blade was a gift to my son, and him alone. I had no use for such a thing.
